<div class="hero">
  <h1>The Four Horsemen in Rotterdam (and Lisa)</h1>
  <p class="dates">28 August – 2 September 2026</p>
</div>

<div class="day">

### Friday, 28 August

<p class="tag">Arrival</p>

**Morning** Arrivals and drop bags

**Afternoon** [Markthal](https://markthal.nl/en/), [cube houses](https://www.kubuswoning.nl/), old port

</div>

<div class="day">

### Saturday, 29 August

**Morning** [Heiderun](https://www.heiderun.nl/) in Ede (Amalia and I running, you're free to arrive later)

**Afternoon** Walk/bike around [Hoge Veluwe National Park](https://hogeveluwe.nl/en) and go to [Kröller-Müller Museum](https://www.krollermuller.nl/en)

</div>

<div class="day">

### Sunday, 30 August

**Morning** Breakfast at [Nachtegaal](https://www.denachtegaal.com/)

**Afternoon** Cruising around Rotterdam

- Witte de Withstraat
- [Maritiem Museum](https://maritiemmuseum.nl/en)
- See my work (nice view on city)
- [Euromast](https://euromast.nl/en/)
- [Fenix](https://www.fenix.nl/en/)
- [Hotel New York](https://hotelnewyork.com/)
- Meent

</div>

<div class="day">

### Monday, 31 August

Options:

- [Bike ride along coast](https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1CWbxbtMsQcsFburmoXfvLQtHzydSeKk&usp=sharing)
- Amsterdam ([Rijksmuseum](https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en))
- Utrecht
- Delft

</div>

<div class="day">

### Tuesday, 1 September

**Day long** [Relaxed biking up and down the Rotte river with many drinks and food](https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1cPH-Ann4Rec_RtiVNPJlM9_DjAiFoTk&usp=sharing)

**Dinner** At home

</div>
